title: Claimant web app: guided and conversational intake, evidence, status
acceptance: src/web/claimant/index.html (plus app.js and pure modules) loads at / and picks tenant from ?tenant=aurelia-mutual|kestrel-point (default aurelia-mutual), applies branding from GET /config/public, and shows a visible tenant picker for the demo

Guided mode asks one question at a time from POST /intake/sessions then answers/next-question, rendering by question type, without client-side showIf logic (server decides); back/edit of previous answer supported via re-answering
Conversational mode renders a chat transcript, accepts free-text answers, and displays AI-prefilled answers (as returned in the IntakeStep) with confirm/edit actions before they are accepted

After submit the page shows the claim number immediately, then an evidence upload step (photos/documents to POST /claims/{id}/documents) and a status page with timeline polling GET /claims/{id} (interval configurable, stops on terminal status, pauses when tab hidden)
If API calls fail with service_unavailable or the route is missing, the UI shows a clear 'service unavailable' state with retry, never a blank page or uncaught error
Spanish toggle appears only when the tenant public config lists es; selection persists and html lang updates
Mobile-first CSS (works at 320px), keyboard operable, focus moves to new question heading, aria-live announcements, skip link, reduced-motion respected

Tests in tests/unit/web/claimant/ with a fake api cover the guided state machine, conversational prefill confirmation, submit->upload->status flow, unavailable state, polling stop rule; node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/web/claimant/ passes
brief:
Build the claimant app under src/web/claimant/ against openapi.yaml; the backend may not exist yet, so all logic must tolerate failures.

KIT INTERFACE (agreed now so apps build in parallel; S1-EXP-01 implements exactly this, apps import it): src/web/shared/api.js exports createApiClient({baseUrl='/api/v1', getToken, fetchImpl=fetch}) returning {get,post,put,patch,del,upload(path,FormData)} that return parsed JSON and throw ApiError {status,code,message,details,requestId} from the error envelope; network failure/5xx/404-on-missing-route throws ApiError with code 'service_unavailable'. src/web/shared/i18n.js exports t(key,params), setLocale, getLocale, registerStrings(locale,table), supportedLocales (en, es). src/web/shared/theme.js exports applyBranding(publicConfig), setScheme('light'|'dark'|'auto'). src/web/shared/devlogin.js exports devLogin(api,{tenant,role}) -> {token,principal}. Components are custom elements registered on import of src/web/shared/components/index.js: fx-field, fx-chips, fx-stepper, fx-upload, fx-chat, fx-timeline, fx-toast, fx-table. Each is attribute/property driven and emits CustomEvents named 'fx-change' (detail {value}) / 'fx-submit'. Shared CSS: src/web/shared/tokens.css and components.css. Apps put pure logic (state, view-models, API orchestration) in plain modules taking an injected api and t, so node tests need no DOM or kit.
Because the kit is built in parallel, import it by absolute path (/shared/...) only from browser-side files (index.html, app.js, views); keep pure logic modules (flow.js guided state machine, chat.js conversational controller, status.js polling controller, upload.js, strings.js registering claimant.* en/es via registerStrings) free of kit imports: they take injected {api, t, clock, timers}. Tests import only those pure modules and use a hand-written fake api returning IntakeStep-shaped objects (read IntakeStep and IntakeSession schemas for fields: question with id/type/prompt/options/help, prefilled, progress, done).

Flow: auth: claimant dev token via devLogin (role claimant, selected tenant) in dev mode; start session {lob, channel:'web', locale}; loop answers; when question is null call submit with an Idempotency-Key header (crypto.randomUUID) and show the claim number from Claim.claimNumber; then upload evidence; then status page with fx-timeline from the claim's history/status. Polling: default 10s, stop on closed/denied/paid-type terminal statuses read from the Claim schema enum. Persist only language and tenant in localStorage wrapped in try/catch. Pitfalls: never trust client-side branching; escape all text (use textContent); do not store tokens in localStorage (memory/sessionStorage only); no real carrier names; write only your paths; run only your tests.

verdicts.reason: Missing routes do not reach the 'service unavailable' state. Live server returns 404 {error:{code:'not_found'}} for POST /intake/sessions, but flow.isUnavailable only treats 404 as unavailable when code==='route_not_found', so the start screen shows a generic inline error with no retry. Tests use a fake that never matches the real server. Fix: treat 404 on the start call (and other non-session-scoped routes) as unavailable, and add a test using the real error shape. Everything else checked is fine: 22/22 tests pass, static files served, contract shapes match.
All criteria met; 24 tests pass; start-404 not_found now reaches unavailable+retry; server-driven showIf, idempotent submit, polling stop/pause, es toggle, a11y verified; in-scope paths only
